title: Time Limit for Disposal of Existing HDB Flats by Owners who Buy a Second Flat
what_it_is: Time Limit for Disposal of Existing HDB Flats by Owners who Buy a Second Flat

sections.label: HDB flat sale extension requests
sections.summary: HDB will assess requests to extend the six-month period to sell an existing flat case by case, with about 13,000 owners expected to collect keys from 2016 to 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB will assess requests for more time to sell off the existing flat based on the merits of each case.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Last year, HDB received 249 such requests for an extension of the six-month period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: During this timeframe in 2015, there were some 41,400 households that bought BTO or resale flats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But if we were to only look at those who still owned a flat when they collected the keys to their new flat, then the number is 13,700 – meaning to say those who still owned a flat when they collected keys to their new flat, that number is 13,700.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, if you look at the appeal cases of 249 over the base of 13,700 – that works out to be less than 2%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Going forward, from 2016 to 2018, about 13,000 existing flat owners are expected to collect the keys to another BTO flat.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: They will, as per the current rules, have to dispose of their existing flats within six months from the time of key collection.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: But if there are requests for an extension of time, HDB will be prepared to exercise flexibility on a case-by-case basis.
